<web-browser>

WebBrowser plugin for browser automation with JavaScript and AJAX support

External WEBBROWSER v2.2.1

Overview

History: This feature existed in old architecture (r655, 2015) using PhantomJS, but was lost during refactoring to new plugin system. This implementation restores the functionality using HtmlUnit.

Important Notes

  • Performance:: Slower than due to JavaScript execution
  • Memory:: Browser engine requires more memory
  • Wait time:: Adjust wait parameter if content not loaded
  • Named pages:: Reuse browser instance with page attribute

Related Processors

<http> <html-to-xml> <xpath>
